mapper.select: select count(1) from hospital_registration where del_flag = '0' and visit_date = curdate()
select count(1) from hospital_visit_record where del_flag = '0' and status = '0' and date(visit_time) = curdate()
select count(1) from hospital_registration where del_flag = '0' and status = '1' and visit_date = curdate()

select coalesce(sum(hss.remain_num), 0) from hospital_schedule_source hss inner join hospital_schedule hs on hss.schedule_id = hs.schedule_id and hs.del_flag = '0' where hss.del_flag = '0' and hss.status = '0' and hs.schedule_date = curdate()
select count(1) from hospital_registration where del_flag = '0' and status = '0' and visit_date = curdate()

select count(1) from hospital_schedule_source hss inner join hospital_schedule hs on hss.schedule_id = hs.schedule_id and hs.del_flag = '0' where hss.del_flag = '0' and hss.status = '0' and hs.schedule_date >= curdate() and hss.remain_num between 1 and 5

select hd.department_id, hd.department_name, coalesce(r.registration_count, 0) as registration_count, coalesce(v.visit_count, 0) as visit_count from hospital_department hd left join ( select department_id, count(1) as registration_count from hospital_registration where del_flag = '0' and visit_date = curdate() group by department_id ) r on hd.department_id = r.department_id left join ( select department_id, count(1) as visit_count from hospital_visit_record where del_flag = '0' and status = '0' and date(visit_time) = curdate() group by department_id ) v on hd.department_id = v.department_id where hd.del_flag = '0' order by (coalesce(r.registration_count, 0) + coalesce(v.visit_count, 0)) desc, hd.department_id asc limit 8

select date_format(visit_date, '%m-%d') as stat_date, count(1) as registration_count, 0 as visit_count from hospital_registration where del_flag = '0' and visit_date between date_sub(curdate(), interval 6 day) and curdate() group by date_format(visit_date, '%m-%d') order by min(visit_date) asc

select date_format(visit_time, '%m-%d') as stat_date, 0 as registration_count, count(1) as visit_count from hospital_visit_record where del_flag = '0' and status = '0' and date(visit_time) between date_sub(curdate(), interval 6 day) and curdate() group by date_format(visit_time, '%m-%d') order by min(date(visit_time)) asc

select hr.registration_id, hr.registration_no, hp.patient_name, hp.phone as patient_phone, hd.department_name, hdoc.doctor_name, hr.visit_date, hr.time_slot, hs.location from hospital_registration hr left join hospital_patient hp on hr.patient_id = hp.patient_id left join hospital_department hd on hr.department_id = hd.department_id left join hospital_doctor hdoc on hr.doctor_id = hdoc.doctor_id left join hospital_schedule hs on hr.schedule_id = hs.schedule_id where hr.del_flag = '0' and hr.status = '0' and hr.visit_date = curdate() order by hr.time_slot asc, hr.registration_time asc, hr.registration_id asc limit 8

select hss.source_id, hd.department_name, hdoc.doctor_name, hs.schedule_date, hs.time_slot, hs.location, hss.total_num, hss.remain_num, hss.status from hospital_schedule_source hss inner join hospital_schedule hs on hss.schedule_id = hs.schedule_id and hs.del_flag = '0' left join hospital_department hd on hss.department_id = hd.department_id left join hospital_doctor hdoc on hss.doctor_id = hdoc.doctor_id where hss.del_flag = '0' and hss.status = '0' and hs.schedule_date >= curdate() and hss.remain_num between 1 and 5 order by hs.schedule_date asc, hs.time_slot asc, hss.remain_num asc, hss.source_id asc limit 8
